profile_text.body:
SentinelOne is a publicly traded cybersecurity company (NYSE: S, CIK 0001583708) that describes itself as offering an AI-powered enterprise cybersecurity platform. According to its website, the platform unifies endpoint, cloud, identity, and data protection, supported by a Security Data Lake. The company positions its approach as AI-native, designed to detect, contain, and respond to threats autonomously and at machine speed, with capabilities covering supply chain attacks, ransomware, behavioral attacks, and credential misuse through a single lightweight agent.

The company's primary tracked AI product is Purple AI, an endpoint security tool built into its broader XDR platform. Purple AI and what the site describes as agentic workflows are said to handle triage, correlation, and routine incident response, allowing security analysts to focus on more complex decisions. SentinelOne's site also notes recognition in the inaugural IDC MarketScape for SIEM, citing its AI-native approach to security data as a factor. The platform additionally includes capabilities described as kill-switch functionality for autonomous response.

No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for SentinelOne at this time.
